## MC Hoster 1.7.0

### New: Dark Names (tick it in tab 5)
Rename the item you hold in any colour. `/dn` (or `/darknames`, `/dm`, `/dark names`) opens a menu with **Rename** and **Reset**.
- **Rename** opens the colour menu: 18 colours, 9 gradients (Sunset, Fire, Ocean, Ice, Toxic, Candy, Galaxy, Royal, Rainbow), your own gradient (type colours like `#FF0000 #0000FF`), and **6 animated names**: Rainbow Wave, Gradient Wave, Pulse, Shine, Fire Flicker and Glitch. Switch Bold, Italic, Underline, Strikethrough and Magic on or off, change the text, see a preview, then Save.
- **Reset** gives the item its own name back.
- Colour formats work when you type a name: `&a` codes, `&#FF8800`, `<#FF8800>` and `<gradient:#FF0000:#0000FF>name</gradient>`. `/dn rename <name>` with codes renames right away.
- Only some ranks for gradients or animations? Use the permissions `darknames.gradients`, `darknames.animated`, `darknames.codes`.

### Fixed
- **Servers kept the old Dark plugins after updating MC Hoster** (so new commands, like `/shop edit`, said Unknown command until you pressed Apply in tab 5). Now every start puts the Dark plugins from this MC Hoster on the server.
- **When a plugin fails to start, MC Hoster tells you** which one and why, instead of its commands just not working.
